independence_declaration.statement: In this run qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG6 scope and changed no candidate file. The product (apps/**, packages/**, migrations, deploy/**, ADRs) and the round-1 repairs (BE-Y1..Y6, DO-Y1, DO-Y2, FE-Y1, ARCH-11..13) were written by the implementer roles listed. The candidate's acceptance suites under tests/qa/** and e2e/** were written before the freeze by earlier qa-verifier authoring tasks (T-DG6-QA-A to H); they are tests, not implementation, and I judged them here as a reviewer. My own tests and mutants stay outside the candidate under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-2/; every build and test ran in disposable copies under $TMPDIR (a complete clone for the candidate id, then a copy without .git to save the shared disk), removed at the end. I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's round-2 record: at the end-of-run identity check git log and git diff --name-only listed the file names of the other reviewers' auto-committed records and evidence, and I opened none of them. A partial test file left in my tests folder by the aborted first launch of this task (09:30Z run) was removed by the orchestrator before I started; I neither used nor read it beyond its name.
